name: RedactThis
longdesc: A self-hosted safety layer for text shared with external AI services. RedactThis combines deterministic Go detectors with a local SmolLM2 model and an independent verification pass, replacing sensitive values with stable typed placeholders. It ships as one Go binary with a private llama.cpp sidecar and stores no requests, analytics, or placeholder mappings.

name: SkyForger
longdesc: A Hypixel SkyBlock forge companion for comparing profitable recipes, expanding nested crafting trees, and tracking active forge slots. SkyForger combines live Bazaar and Auction House evidence with profile progression, inventory checks, and a maintained catalog of more than 150 forge and gemstone recipes while making uncertain or missing market data explicit.

name: bookThing
longdesc: A Rust desktop application for high-throughput archival capture with gPhoto2-compatible cameras. bookThing keeps live preview, capture settings, and large exports responsive with dedicated workers, supports retaking and renumbering pages, and produces portable ZIP archives containing converted page images, bibliographic metadata, and an export log.

name: Favicon Kit
longdesc: A dependency-free favicon generator that runs entirely in the browser. It turns one square PNG into a real multi-image ICO, Apple and Android icons, a web manifest, and ready-to-paste HTML, then packages everything into a ZIP without uploading the source image or relying on a backend.

name: Peek CSV
longdesc: A focused C++ command-line utility that makes CSV files readable without leaving the terminal. Peek CSV validates structure, explains malformed rows with a nearby data window, reports file metadata, and renders padded, centered tables with formatting controls suited to piping through less for large datasets.

name: Solaris API
longdesc: An Express API for mathematical Salah time calculation and Quranic verse retrieval. Solaris accepts coordinates, dates, and time zones for daily prayer schedules, and provides configurable Arabic text, translations, and transliterations for individual ayat or ranges through a compact HTTP interface.
